subject: A simple density correction for changed survey effort?

messages.author: e1ad8e4570c0b9e5
messages.subject: A simple density correction for changed survey effort?
parts:
I analyzed point count data to estimate density of a number of bird species
- no problems there. I miscalculated the survey effort as 50 when it
should have 60. Other than re-running the analysis, is there an easy way
to correct the DISTANCE density estimates, e.g., using a simple percentage
correction?
